<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917648_theRebbe_921" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917648_theRebbe_921__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B"S.</t>
    <t s="1">Motzaei Shabbos Kodesh Parshas Vayakhel-Pekudei,</t>
    <t s="2">Parshas HaChodesh,</t>
    <t s="3">25 Adar 5739*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the change in which month is considered first, from Tishrei before the Giving of the Torah to Nissan afterward, based on Targum Yonasan.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"This month is for you the head of the months, it is the first for you of the months of the year."</t>
    <t s="1">And the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, brings in his maamar beginning with these words</t>
    <t s="2">(at the beginning of his arrival in the USA)</t>
    <t s="3">that it is stated in Targum Yonasan on the verse</t>
    <t s="4">"In the month of the strong ones etc., it is the seventh month"</t>
    <t s="5">(which refers to the month of Tishrei),</t>
    <t s="6">"The ancients called it the first month etc., and now it is the seventh month,"</t>
    <t s="7">that before the Giving of the Torah</t>
    <t s="8">Tishrei was called the first month because in it the world was created,</t>
    <t s="9">and now,</t>
    <t s="10">after the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="11">Nissan is the first month and Tishrei is the seventh month.</t>
    <t s="12">And he clarifies in this,</t>
    <t s="13">that since initially Tishrei was the first month, why was it changed so that Nissan should be the first.</t>
    <t s="14">And if it is because of the redemption that was in Nissan,</t>
    <t s="15">this itself requires explanation,</t>
    <t s="16">for the beginning of the redemption was in Tishrei,</t>
    <t s="17">for on Rosh HaShanah</t>
    <t s="18">(the first of Tishrei)</t>
    <t s="19">the servitude ceased for our forefathers,</t>
    <t s="20">and why is the month of the redemption</t>
    <t s="21">(the complete one)</t>
    <t s="22">specifically Nissan.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Tishrei is the source of natural vitality for the year, while Nissan is the head for the miraculous, transcendent divine flow.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">And it should be noted,</t>
    <t s="2">that in several discourses</t>
    <t s="3">the precision in this—that Nissan is the head of the months—is in that the first of Tishrei is Rosh HaShanah</t>
    <t s="4">(that this, that the first of Tishrei is Rosh HaShanah, is also now after the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah),</t>
    <t s="5">for since that which is called Rosh HaShanah is</t>
    <t s="6">because it includes the vitality of the entire year, analogous to the head which includes the vitality of all the limbs of the body,</t>
    <t s="7">and it is then divided into twelve heads of months, and each Rosh Chodesh into thirty</t>
    <t s="8">(twenty-nine)</t>
    <t s="9">days,</t>
    <t s="10">it is therefore found that the vitality of the month of Nissan is from Tishrei,</t>
    <t s="11">and here it is stated that Nissan is the head of the months and the first of the months of the year</t>
    <t s="12">(even to the month of Tishrei).</t>
    <t s="13">And they explain in this,</t>
    <t s="14">that the vitality drawn down in Tishrei for the entire year is in the aspect of boundary and measure</t>
    <t s="15">(which, in general, is the vitality that is clothed within the creations in their inwardness),</t>
    <t s="16">which is the root of the conduct of nature.</t>
    <t s="17">And this, that Nissan is called "head," is regarding the drawing down of the light of Ein Sof, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="18">which is the root of miraculous conduct that is above nature.</t>
    <t s="19">And based on this they explain</t>
    <t s="20">also this, that Tishrei is Rosh HaShanah and Nissan is the head of the months,</t>
    <t s="21">for the conduct of nature,</t>
    <t s="22">which is always uniform,</t>
    <t s="23">is analogous to the course of the sun</t>
    <t s="24">(shanah [year] from the word shinui [change/repetition],</t>
    <t s="25">that the same thing returns and is repeated again),</t>
    <t s="26">and miraculous conduct, whose essence is renewal</t>
    <t s="27">[that sometimes the Holy One, blessed be He, disrupts the conduct of nature for a period of time],</t>
    <t s="28">is analogous to the course of the moon,</t>
    <t s="29">which is renewed each month</t>
    <t s="30">(chodesh [month] from the word chiddush [renewal]).</t>
    <t s="31">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="32">that this which is precise in this maamar—that before the Exodus from Egypt Tishrei was the first of the months—</t>
    <t s="33">the emphasis in this is,</t>
    <t s="34">that before the Exodus from Egypt Tishrei was the first and the head also for the drawing down of Divinity that is above nature</t>
    <t s="35">[and this is also understood from that which even the beginning of the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt was in Tishrei],</t>
    <t s="36">so why was it changed now that Nissan is the first.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
